Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Ianin Nethai: 28-year-old man, 195 cm (very-tall), plus-size heavy construction with substantial natural mass, skin value band-3-light-medium. Face: soft rectangular face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; subtle age lines. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blue-teal, medium-loose, deliberate accent: contrasting clipped section. Wardrobe: fitted-vest-system, specifically a fitted cloth vest system over a soft shirt, high-waist trousers, and flexible boots; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette marigold-green. Visible personal details: no accessory and no tattoo. Make the garment hem and outer silhouette the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: feet plant evenly while fingertips touch a small personal keepsake. Include a travel tally cord only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance.
